description: Follow volleyball with API-Volleyball: games and results with every set's score, live while they are played, standings, team season statistics, head-to-head records and bookmakers' pre-match odds, for more than 260 men's and women's leagues and cups, from Italy's SuperLega, Poland's PlusLiga and Turkey's Efeler Ligi to the CEV Champions League, the Nations League and the world championships. Needs an API-SPORTS key; the free plan allows 100 requests a day.
